description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for testing the rendering of admonitions in Markdown content, specifically within the AdmonitionRenderer component of the documentation tools. It verifies various admonition types and behaviors using data-driven tests.

classes.name: AdmonitionRendererTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests the rendering of admonition blocks in Markdown documents when processed by the documentation rendering system.

methods.name: provideAdmonitionCases
methods.description: Provides various input and expected output pairs for testing admonition rendering, used as a data provider in unit tests.

methods.name: testRenderLink
methods.description: A test method that verifies the correct conversion of different admonition Markdown syntax into corresponding HTML output, using a virtual filesystem and configuration setup.
